The 6th Science & Technology Exchange Program (STEP) with focus on:
🔖Themes:
🔹 Water-Energy Nexus
🔹 Health

🔖Macro Issues:
🔸 Scientific Collaboration
🔸 Women in Science & Technology
🔸 Financing for Science & Technology
🔸 Science Communication

will be held simultaneous with the Mustafa(PBUH) Prize 2019 ceremony in Tehran, Iran, on November 9-12. 🗓
